items.title: Move to main, Keep in beta & update, Remove from both
items.text: Each change on the Beta review page now has three choices instead of two. After you pick one, a note box opens: "Change anything first?" for Move to main, "What should be updated?" for Keep in beta & update, and "Why remove it?" for Remove from both. The note saves when you click away or press Enter (Shift+Enter for a new line). Click your choice again to undo it.

items.title: Disagreements are shown
items.text: If testers pick different options for the same change, it's marked "You disagree" in red, and the list for Claude shows who picked what. Filters: All, Not decided, Main, Beta & update, Remove, Disagree.

items.title: Old ticks carry over
items.text: Ticks made in V0.6.5 count as the new choices: Push to main becomes Move to main, and Keep in beta becomes Keep in beta & update.

items.title: "No beta yet" instead of an error
items.text: If nothing has been published to the beta build yet, Updates now says "No beta yet" instead of "Couldn't check for updates … HTTP 404".

items.title: Clearer Build card
items.text: The badge next to Build now says "You're on Main" or "You're on Beta", so it's clear which build is running, separate from the one you picked.
